profiles.prompt: Original illustrated male office chibi sprite sheet. Warm tan skin, chestnut side-swept hair with pointed locks and forelock, expressive large brown eyes, cobalt blue collared rolled-up shirt, cream undershirt, navy trousers and brown shoes. Hand-drawn 2D dark sepia outline, cel shading, soft painted highlights, 2.5 heads tall; not a 3D toy, pixel art or mascot. Camera fixed elevated30-degree isometric. Four columns: southeast front3/4, southwest front3/4, northwest rear3/4, northeast rear3/4. Six rows: idle, idle blink, walk left step, walk right step, seated typing A, seated typing B. Rear seated head turned in profile to show cheek/eye while body faces workstation. No chair, desk, props, bubble, shadow, text or background. Transparent padding; foot baseline94% of cell height, standing hair top8%, seated20%; same head size throughout.

Portrait sheet 1024x1536, exactly FOUR columns by SIX rows, each character separate with generous transparent padding. Camera elevated 30 degrees. Columns left to right: facing southeast front three-quarter; southwest front three-quarter; northwest rear three-quarter; northeast rear three-quarter. Seated rear views glance over shoulder enough to show cheek/profile but torso still faces its direction. Same outfit, head size, identity, scale through all24 poses. All full bodies including shoes inside their cell, at least20px gap between figures. Head top8% for standing and20% seated; feet baseline94%. Hands extend naturally toward an imaginary keyboard in seated poses. Warm thoughtful smile; authentic small employee character, no animal ears.
